title: The Slop Drop
one_liner: Watch an AI 'bulk-solve' 722 math problems in real time, with a live meter of time, cost, and success rate.
headline: Watch a 722-tile grid "bulk-solve" math problems live, with a running meter of compute-hours, cost, and solve rate — then flip a toggle to feel a decade of progress versus two weeks.

episode.title: OpenAI Bulk-Solves 722 Math Problems, Anthropic’s Cruelty Policy, and Elon’s Quadrillion-Dollar SpaceX | EP #302

history.summary: A clean, self-contained simulator that closely tracks the episode's actual numbers (722 problems, 3 hrs/problem, 15–20% solve rate, ~$24M, decade-vs-two-weeks framing), with honest "Simulated data" labeling and a working run/pause/reset/speed control set. The human-vs-AI timeline toggle is a nice conceptual device but animates at the same real-world speed in both modes, slightly undercutting the dramatic time-compression it's meant to convey. No console errors, no external dependencies, clean mobile layout.
